reader.requirement: At --std 85 no line of a page heading report group may be presented on or after FIRST DETAIL integer-3 (last permitted line integer-3 - 1), for an absolute PH, a relative PH placed from HEADING, and a relative PH placed after a report heading on the same page (rule 3b, from the RH's final LINE-COUNTER); since 1985 has no PRESENT WHEN and no run-time report exception, every such placement is fixed by the description and is a syntax-rule violation (XIII.3.15.3 SR1, XIII.3.8.3 SR8b). Witness pb1270 covers only the absolute PH on the boundary.

reader.notes: Absolute and HEADING-seeded relative page headings are held to FIRST DETAIL - 1 at compile time. MinimumLastLine walks a relative page heading from the HEADING seed only (no seed from the report heading's final LINE-COUNTER), so a relative PH after a report heading that reaches FIRST DETAIL compiles, and the run presents it there (FirstLineTarget: LineCounter + integer-2) where the first detail overprints it. The 3.10.7 text is reconstructed (PB4952); the printed XIII.3.8.3 SR8b and XIII.3.8.4 GR1c state the same limit.
